name: Trim Interstage — Template (Between Coats)
intent: Between-coats interstage on trim — inspect, light sand, patch defects, touch up caulk, spot-coat, dust. Always fires for fine-finish trim. Extended by per-substrate MOD_INTERSTAGE_<substrate> modules.
doctrine: Default height:true matches the majority of trim substrates. Floor-adjacent substrates (baseboard, shoe mold, chair rail, wainscot cap) and door frame/casing override height:false. Mirrors the height-default choice in MOD_TEMPLATE_TRIM_PAINT/PRIME_INITIAL.
